variants.headline: Home world punishes the colony
variants.sub: A punishment has been imposed on {colony} by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has punished the colony. The action establishes a punitive development in the relationship, not the particular effects of that action. Scrutiny of {target} should address the use of authority without adding an unreported restriction, financial loss or change in supplies to the account.

Our principles require scrutiny of power when it punishes, not only when it makes promises. The relationship between the colony and the home world cannot be reduced to the prestige of the authority involved. A political argument should explain why a consequence is just, rather than treating power as its own justification.

The position of {target} should be assessed without supplying an unreported offence or penalty. This paper records the punitive action while reserving judgment on particulars not established in the report. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.

variants.sub: The colony is the subject of punitive action by the home world.
